description: Position des passages à niveau - Positie van de overwegen - Position of level crossings is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. This dataset includes the geographical position of level crossings in service at intersections between public roads and the Infrabel network. It means: On the Infrabel network: not all level crossings are on Infrabel’s network. The level crossings of tourist lines, certain intersections in port areas,... are managed by other parties. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
